How many roots of z = −64 have strictly positive real part?
(A) 1 (B) 2 (C) 3 (D) 4 (E) 5

solution.text:
The roots have modulus 2 and arguments π/6, π/2, 5π/6, 7π/6, 3π/2, 11π/6. Only the first
and last have positive real part; the two purely imaginary roots do not count.
